cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: See What This Took
cards.instruction: Make someone recognize the courage, restraint, or emotional labor your choices required.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Compare the angry letter with the one I sent. Notice the crossing-out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I appreciate the apology you sent. Why show me the angry version?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Because 'sorry' took ten minutes. Not sending the rest took all night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now I'm tempted to read what you spared me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please admire the thickness with it shut. I'd like one night's restraint to survive breakfast.

mechanism: A corrects how B evaluates a choice so B recognizes the restraint or courage it took.
confusable: Seeking approval of the result differs from demanding recognition of the invisible effort required to choose it.
comparison: An edited apology hides angry material; a committee resignation embodies practiced refusal.
seedUse: Keep the letter restraint and refusal practice distinct; correction must reveal effort without neutral coaching commentary.
